epicfight:forbidden_strength: When stamina runs out, actions cost health instead.
epicfight:death_harvest: Killing an enemy with a weapon innate skill refunds weapon charge.
epicfight:hypervitality: Innate skills use stamina when your weapon charge is not full.
epicfight:endurance: For up to 8 s, a hit while you prepare an attack costs stamina instead of stunning you.
epicfight:stamina_pillager: Killing your target restores 30% of your missing stamina.
wom:adrenaline: Below 20% health, deal 60% more damage and take 40% less.
wom:buster_parade: Wind up your weapon for 1 to 2 s, then release a mighty blow that ignores guard and knocks out a target caught blocking or attacking.
wom:shadow_step: Sink into the shadows and dash faster than light, immune to physical attacks meanwhile.
wom:vengeful_parry: Put you in a guarding stance for 2sec.
wom:inner_growth: Regenerate 2 innate power every second (+0.1 per level of Blast Protection on your armour).
dualgreatswords:dualgreatsword: Lets you dual-wield greatswords, one in each hand.
wom:bull_charge: Charge forward pushing away any entity that come across your path.
wom:ender_obscuris: Teleport behind the last target you hit within 30 blocks, immune to physical attacks meanwhile.
epicfight:bonebreaker: Repeated hits on the same target deal stacking bonus damage.
wom:spider_techniques: Hold sprint and jump at a wall to run along it, and leap from wall to wall.
wom:ender_step: A quick teleport away from danger, immune to physical attacks meanwhile.
wom:precise_roll: A faster, further and cheaper roll.
wom:shooting_style: With an empty hand, hold sneak while attacking to kick (a 3-kick combo).
dodge_parry_reward:heal2: A perfect dodge or a perfect parry instantly restores some health.
wom:meditation: Sneak still for 2 s to meditate; the longer you meditate, the longer the buff (stage 1: +40% damage; stage 2: +30% attack speed and Speed I; stage 3: 50% less damage taken and Regeneration I).
wom:heart_shield: A 20-point shield that recovers while you take no action.
wom:mindset: Above 80% health, deal 30% more damage and take 20% less.
efs_iss:auto_heal: While you have mana, it is spent automatically to restore the same share of your health.
combat_evolution:shield_counter: With a shield in the off hand, Guard + Weapon Innate swings it; blocking an attack this way stuns the enemy, restores stamina and grants stun immunity, Resistance and Strength.
wom:pain_anticipation: After 2 s without acting, your next action grants 2 s of stun immunity and 40% less damage taken.
epicfight:impact_guard: Guarding costs less stamina and also blocks explosions, fire, magic and projectiles at reduced damage.
epicfightx:combat_mastery_i: Dodge in the middle of an attack, or attack straight out of a dodge.
epicfightx:combat_mastery_ii: Sprinting just after a dodge enters a Dash, which drains stamina while it lasts.
efs_iss:hasty_casting: Spells take half as long to cast, and much faster movement while casting.
epicfight:technician: Dodging just before a hit restores stamina.
dodge_parry_reward:damage_boost1: A perfect parry grants Strength I for 2 s.
wom:dancing_blade: Every 4th hit that lands deals 80% more damage.
wom:dopamine: Damage dealt by a dash attack is turned into stamina (4 s cooldown).
epicfight:revelation: Guarding, parrying and dodging build stacks; at full stacks unleash a stunning counter-attack.
wom:manipulator: Blocking restores stamina: 60% of what you are missing on a perfect block, up to 30% on a normal one.
efn:parry_master: Parries charge your weapon skill and build up a chance to ignore enemy defence; with a katana, parries open Ichimonji counters.
cdmoveset:fatalfalsh: Lock onto a low-health enemy and perform a kill, which cannot be interrupted during execution (Weapons allowed: uchigatana, katana, tachi, longsword).
wom:voodoo_magic: Losing health restores half as much stamina and losing stamina half as much health; sneak to turn health into stamina; stamina no longer regenerates on its own.
wom:natural_sprinter: Hold sprint for 1 s to break into a faster run; release it for a burst step, and sprint-jumps carry further.
epicfight:adrenaline_fiend: Stamina starts regenerating at once when you kill a mob.
epicfight:adaptive_skin: Take 15% less damage from the damage types that hit you recently, stacking up to 3 times.
wom:proximity_exploiter: For each living things within 5 blocks of you, regenerate 3 innate power every 0.5s sec.
wom:time_travel: Register your position and health on cast.
wom:aqua_maneuvre: Swim faster, and release jump to propel yourself through the water.
efs_iss:mana_shield: Damage taken is paid for with mana, in proportion to the hit against your max health.
efs_iss:breathe_again: A fatal hit is cancelled by spending all your mana.
efs_iss:blood_into_mana: While your health is above 20%, spells cost health instead of mana.
wom:soul_protection: You cannot guard; your soul gives 20% damage negation and every second summons a soul worth 1% more; each hit taken removes 3 souls.
epicfight:meteor_slam: Slam into the ground from the air; the higher the fall, the more damage it deals and stamina it costs.
wom:perfect_bulwark: Holding Guard stance will block attacks from all directions at low progressive stamina cost.
dodge_parry_reward:heal3: Instantly restores 3 health (1.5 hearts) after a perfect dodge or perfect parry.
efs_iss:rapid_chant: Much shorter cast times, and channelled spells last much longer.
efs_iss:reserve_mana: Refills your mana at once when it drops below 10%.
epicfight:demolition_leap: Charge up and launch yourself where you look; halves your next fall damage.
efs_iss:magic_sword: Automatically casts the currently selected spell when a weapon swing ends.
wom:all_eyes_on_you: Blocking or dodging 4 different attacks makes you slowly regenerate stamina and innate power for 8 s.
wom:dodge_master: For a moment after casting, dodge out of any hit by instinct, chaining dodges; repeated casts cost double stamina.
epicfight:catharsis: Dodging attacks charges your weapon's innate skill.
epicfight:emergency_escape: Dodge even while being hit or out of stamina, and cancel attacks into a dodge.
epicfight:vengeance: Bonus damage against whoever last hurt you; killing them grants a fading damage boost.
wom:critical_knowledge: Attacks, arrows included, have a 20% chance to crit for double damage; Fire Protection on your armor raises the chance and Blast Protection the damage.
cdmoveset:wolf_dodge: Allows you to use different actions to dodge. A successful dodge can trigger special effects and restore weapon charge.
cdmoveset:bloodwolf: When the wolf howls, it is time for a counterattack. Gain the protection of the wolf god by dodging and defeating enemies. When the skill level reaches 10, you will gain the protection of the wolf god, enhancing your attacks and having a chance to interrupt enemy attacks.
wom:arrow_tenacity: Prevent the stun from arrows damage. This skill is permanent, thus you can use another passive on top of it but, you'll only keep the current passive if you die.
wom:avatar_of_might: Hold sneak for 2 s to release a shockwave that pushes enemies away and makes you briefly immune to stuns.
wom:vampirize: Heal 20% of the damage you deal.
wom:lethal_focus: Every hit raises your damage up to a cap; after 2 s without acting the bonus drains quickly.
epicfight:berserker: More attack damage and attack speed the more health you are missing.
wom:punishment_kick: A forceful kick that stuns hard, and knocks out an enemy caught mid-attack.
mdvlcraft:shunpo: You cannot guard or block; press guard with a parry's timing to flash aside and dodge the attack (Dodge Master's sidestep), for no stamina. Works with any weapon.
